name_reason: Follows data_fd2_<domain=battle>_<descriptor> convention; battle-core AI scratch var. Descriptor 'ai_best_spell_target_y' precisely names the role (enemy-AI best-scoring offensive-spell cast-tile Y coordinate). The '_y' suffix is the coordinate axis (semantic), not a Ghidra address residue. Consistent with the sibling result group (_target_x @0x53C27, _spell_id @0x53C2F, _score @0x53C23) and the physical/item analogues.
purpose: Enemy AI offensive-spell scoring scratchpad holding the tile Y coordinate of the best (highest-scoring) spell cast tile chosen by fd2_ai_score_offensive_spell.
logic_summary: fd2_ai_score_offensive_spell evaluates every castable spell over every reachable cast tile; whenever a (spell,tile) candidate wins the running score tournament it stores the tile's Y byte (zero-extended to a dword) here at 0x15B08, together with the sibling group best_score/best_target_x/best_spell_id. fd2_execute_ai_offensive_spell later reads it (0x15375, 0x153B6) and passes it as the Y argument to fd2_compute_aoe_targets and fd2_pan_cursor_to_tile_animated to actually cast at the chosen tile.
element_semantics: Single scalar: battle tile Y coordinate (an unsigned byte tile-grid row index zero-extended into the dword slot). Source byte read via MOVZX EAX,byte ptr[tile_pos+1] then stored full-dword at 0x15B08.
comment_original_issue: Source comment was already accurate and precise (kept). Ghidra side: the descriptive documentation was stranded in the deprecated PRE_COMMENT field while PLATE_COMMENT was empty, contrary to the data-plate-in-PLATE_COMMENT rule.
notes: BSS scalar in .object2 (reads as zeros). Has a game-side writer (0x15B08) -> not const. Disassembly confirms full-dword store of EAX to [0x53C2B] at 0x15B08, with the value sourced from MOVZX byte (zero-extended tile-Y). src comment at btl_aisc.c line 639 plus the group header (lines 626-631) are accurate, so btl_aisc.c was left untouched (no working-tree change). Created the proper PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline Java API per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism and cleared the now-redundant deprecated PRE_COMMENT. Name rename (if ever) is deferred to Stage 2; verdict is keep so no rename needed.
